capabilities: Set individual notes to LTR, RTL, or auto direction
Remember text direction per note across sessions
Control note direction via front matter
Set a default direction for notes without an explicit setting
Toggle direction via command, hotkey, status bar item, or Canvas cards
extras: Canvas support has documented limitations: cards linked to notes follow the note's direction, and cards without an associated file always use the default direction. The author accepts donations via 'buy me a coffee'.
intentEvidence: This plugin extends the built-in RTL support of Obsidian by adding some extra features.
problem: Obsidian's built-in RTL support only auto-detects direction per line, with no way to set or remember a direction for a whole note.

relations.evidence: This plugin extends the built-in RTL support of Obsidian by adding some extra features.

summary: Text direction plugin that adds per-note and default LTR/RTL controls on top of Obsidian's built-in RTL support for Arabic, Hebrew, and Farsi.
